judged_text: The public `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` method and the `embeddable_hosts`/`embed_category` settings are removed outright with no deprecation shim, while `type: host_list` disappears from site_settings.yml. Any out-of-tree plugin or theme calling `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` (a documented-ish extension point) breaks with NoMethodError on upgrade instead of getting a graceful false/deprecation warning; the old body also contained an unreachable second matching block that is deleted without comment, so this historical behavior quirk is undocumented anywhere.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` entirely from `app/models/site_setting.rb` and deletes the `embeddable_hosts` and `embed_category` settings from `config/site_settings.yml` (and their locale strings), with a migration that deletes those site_settings rows. Core callers are updated to use `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` and category lookup via `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, so it’s not an internal correctness defect, but it is a concrete backwards-compatibility/API-surface break for any external plugin/theme calling the removed method or relying on the removed settings, with no deprecation shim shown in the diff.
